    assert factorize(2) == [2]
    assert factorize(3) == [3]
    assert factorize(4) == [2, 2]
    assert factorize(6) == [2, 3]
    assert factorize(12) == [2, 2, 3]
    assert factorize(17) == [17]
    assert factorize(49) == [7, 7]
    assert factorize(100) == [2, 2, 5, 5]
    assert factorize(360) == [2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 5]
    assert factorize(97) == [97]
    assert factorize(1024) == [2] * 10
    assert factorize(999) == [3, 3, 3, 37]
    assert factorize(30030) == [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13]
    assert factorize(104729) == [104729]
    for n, expected in [(1, []), (2, [2]), (4, [2, 2]), (12, [2, 2, 3]), (100, [2, 2, 5, 5])]:
        result = factorize(n)
        assert result == expected
        assert result == sorted(result)
    for n in [2, 3, 4, 6, 12, 49, 100, 360, 999, 1024, 30030]:
        result = factorize(n)
        p = 1
        for x in result:
            p *= x
        assert p == n
        for x in result:
            assert factorize(x) == [x]
